name: Galbot G1
summary: A humanoid from Beijing's Galbot, a Peking University–linked startup: a two-armed upper body on a wheeled base with a telescoping torso that lets it reach from floor level to high shelves. Galbot has focused on unmanned retail and pharmacy pilots and on being a hardware platform for embodied-AI foundation models.
notable: Liftable torso on a wheeled base for large vertical reach
Deployed in unmanned retail and pharmacy pilots
